# Vendored third-party bundles

These are verbatim published builds used so the tool runs without
bootstrapping the monorepo:

- `babel-parser.mjs`     — @babel/parser **8.0.6** (ESM, `importAttributes`)
- `babel-parser-7.cjs`   — @babel/parser **7.28.5** (CJS, `importAssertions`)

@babel/parser is distributed by the Babel project under the MIT License
(see the repository LICENSE file). No code changes were made to the bundles.
